tl.help: Chronology deals you cards to place on the line. The Thread connects two cards with documented links. The Chronicle reads the club's documented history in order.
tl.thread.title: The Chronicle
tl.gap.same: Same day as the entry before.
tl.gap.unstated: The archive dates this only to the year, so no gap is stated.
tl.yearOnly.note: The archive gives the year, not the day.
tl.source.none: No source is listed for this entry.
tl.hint: Swipe the card or use the arrow keys.
tl.empty.title: Nothing in the chronicle yet
tl.empty: The archive holds no dated events for {club} yet. Entries appear here as research dates them — nothing is filled in by guesswork.
tl.coverage: {n} documented entries, {exact} dated to the day. Documented history only — not the club's full story.
tl.c.title: Place it on the line
tl.c.intro: You start with one dated card. Place {n} more where they happened; every card lands on its real date, even after a miss.
tl.c.rule.tap: Tap a gap on the line to put the card there.
tl.c.rule.lives: {lives} lives. A wrong place costs one.
tl.c.rule.timer: Each card is timed: {a}, then {b}, then {c} seconds in stages of four.
tl.c.rule.score: Faster right answers and longer streaks score more.
tl.c.cat.short: Short run · {n} placements. {club} has {have} dated events; a full run needs {need}.
tl.c.cat.note: A short run is scored apart from a full one, never against it.
tl.c.locked.title: Chronology is not open yet
tl.c.locked.body: Chronology needs {need} approved events on exact calendar days. {club} has {have}.
th.title: The Thread
th.intro: Connect the start card to the end card through documented links, one stop at a time. Every stop you add must be linked to the one before it.
th.rule.links: A link is real only if the archive documents it. You see the link and its sources after a stop is accepted.
th.rule.integrity: A tear costs one integrity: a card with no documented link, a move backward in time where time only runs forward, or two matches in a row where that is forbidden. The same mistake costs once.
th.rule.close: Close the route when the last stop links to the end card and every rule is met. An unfinished close is explained and costs nothing.
th.rule.tap: Tap a card to add it. Undo takes the last stop back. Nothing is timed.
th.mode.why: This club’s documented links built {n} sound level(s). Tiers {missing} could not be built honestly, so they are left out rather than relaxed.
th.rule.noConsecutive: No two matches in a row
th.move.no-edge: No documented link joins those two.
th.move.backward: That goes backward in time, and this level only runs forward.
th.move.consecutive: Two matches in a row are not allowed here.
th.move.full: The route already has the most stops it may have.
th.move.used: That card is already on the route.
th.move.not-in-hand: That card is not in your hand.
th.close.invalid: The route is not a valid chain yet.
th.close.stops: The route has the wrong number of stops.
th.close.missing: A required stop or type is still missing.
th.close.no-edge: The last stop is not documented as linked to the end card.
th.close.backward: The last link goes backward in time.
th.close.consecutive: The last link would put two matches in a row.
th.err: Could not check that. Try again.
th.offline: You appear to be offline. Reconnect and try again.
th.closed.title: Thread closed
th.closed.line: Your route used {stops} stops. The shortest documented route has {optimum}.
th.failed.title: The thread tore
th.failed.line: Out of integrity. A documented route with {optimum} stops existed; here it is, with its sources.
th.locked.title: The Thread is not open yet
th.locked.body: The Thread needs typed, approved, sourced links between people, teams, places, seasons and matches. {club} has no route we can build honestly yet, and we do not invent links to fill the gap.
th.locked.need: A level needs a start, an end and a documented route between them that also meets its rules.
